scope: V2 package 1: checked partition-local graph writes
source_qualification: Final tested code is unchanged. This acceptance record, archive index and backlog closure are documentation/evidence-only changes after validation.
accepted_behaviour: Typed graph writes on two declared partitions of one GraphID, three disk-backed voters per partition.
Canonical, declared and current-presence indexes and complete ordered CDC; retained mutation-then-historical reads.
All nine dependency kinds; unknown, remote, stale and corrupt authority refuse without partial graph effects.
Shared consumptive representation admission from request ownership through composition; existing caps unchanged.
Six-voter disk reopen, nonempty snapshot activation and leader failover.

corrections: Reserve fresh scalar backing before decoding, including scope and descriptor clones.
Reject persisted ownership epochs below the published initial epoch without graph effects.

additive_successor.status: history API normal/race, full-module coverage, fmt, vet, build and pinned lint/security/vulnerability gates pass
additive_successor.qualification: All existing Go files remain byte-identical to the whole-module race checkpoint. The two added history API files have focused successor race coverage; no successor whole-module race is claimed.

validation.coverage_method: Coalesce duplicate coverpkg blocks by source location and OR execution counts before summing statements.
validation.vulnerability_qualification: Zero reachable vulnerabilities; noncalled imported/required advisories are preserved in the raw report.

limits: Local disk-backed replicas do not prove physical multi-host durability.
No overall V2, cross-partition transaction, certified-cut or capacity acceptance.
Runtime RSS observations are bounded test-process measurements, not deployment capacity commitments.
